# FLX-7141: the Simulation declares no forecasts to make

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

`fluxsim forecast make` registers the items of extensions['com.agentics.flux/1'].forecasts. The Simulation the command read declares none, so there is nothing to forecast.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7141
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
